block the way forward."

"Your bag looks full.

"Over ten years ago, a young man
went into the labyrinth like you."

"He was very brave,
and he came back alive, but..."

"Don't throw your life away.
Take care."
"You made it back safe, it seems."

"I've been in the labyrinth too.
It's no place for the half-hearted."

"Many have died there.
You be careful too."

"This is all
I can do for you."

"...Your bag looks full.
Come back when you've made room."
"It feels like a long time since I was here."

"When I was a kid,
the king of Rikistria was in the labyrinth."

"A hero killed that king
and saved this town,
and he was more than just strong."

"Remember the ring you brought me?
That hero found it
for me in the labyrinth."

"Sure, I asked him to look for it,
but I never thought he'd go along
with a kid's whim like that."
"You have the same eyes as that hero."

"You can surely destroy
the black dragon."

"Don't worry about the town.
I can manage."

"They seem more frequent
than when I came over ten years ago."

"It was right to get out
of the labyrinth early."

"The big quakes keep coming,
so our survey is on hold."

"We've been ordered out of the labyrinth.
Don't wait until something happens to you.
Don't go too deep."

"They'll take our results to the capital
and decide what to do next."

"In the end we did nothing...
What will become of this place?"

"The grown-ups were saying
there's fruit lying around in there?"

"My dad went into the labyrinth
just for me."

"He went to pick
a rare fruit."
"He says he'll give it to me."

"I hope Dad brings the labyrinth fruit
home soon."

"Dad went all the way into the labyrinth
to look for the rare fruit, but..."
"You shouldn't eat things off the ground."

"So even if I can't eat
the labyrinth fruit...
Yeah. It's fine."
"I'd rather die than get a tummy ache."

"He promised to bring me
a rare fruit from the labyrinth."

"Knowing Dad,
maybe he ate it all himself..."

"Mister,
isn't that the fruit from the labyrinth?"

"Fine.
Dad will bring me one for sure."

"You and Dad
only ever think about food."
"Don't blame me if you get sick."

"My brother only talks about
the fruit in the labyrinth lately."

"My brother eats all the time,
that's why he got so fat."

"But he didn't find anything,
after going all the way into the labyrinth."

"Dad looks a bit thinner.
I'm worried."

"Maybe he did something he's not used to.
It's not like him."

"Dad is so thin now, I'm worried.
I liked him better before."

"I won't scold him for eating too much,
I just want him back the way he was."

"I love Dad best
when he's just being Dad."

"Dad went into the labyrinth
and hasn't come back..."

"Dad hasn't come back,
and now my brother is gone too."

"I've got something very valuable.
Want to buy it?"

"This.
The crest of the royal house of Rikistria."
"Come back when you have the money."

"Your bag looks heavy.
I'll wait. Go make room."

"The scholar says
this can work the royal devices."

"If you're going through the labyrinth,
it can't hurt to have one."

"I've got something rare.

"A magic tool.

the labyrinth's devices."

"I see.

"A magic tool.

"I see.
I'll find someone else, then."

"1500G.

"3000G.

"It bothers the other customers.

"He holds up protecting the town

"The quakes keep coming here.

"I'll never leave this town.
It's where I was born. It's mine."
"He hasn't been here at all lately."

"I see.

"You're exploring the labyrinth, I hear.
Will you do me a favor?"

Make it quick, please."

"Now that your purse is full,

"The survey team seems to be in the labyrinth.

"I don't want to go to the labyrinth.

"It's delicious, right?
But it's in the labyrinth..."

"People like you are why
I hated the labyrinth..."

"I told my kids I'd bring some home...
I can't face them."

"They said Mantrap Fruit was delicious,
so the survey people must have eaten it all."
